$description: Authored. The launch edit, as runs of song bars played in order. Every splice is on a bar line. 'end' plays to the end of the track. The first run starting at bar 1 keeps the silence before it.

pieces.why: the stop-start fill that sets up the drop

a built transition: drop 1's last four bars again, closed down to a breath, opened back up under a riser and a snare roll, then a beat of silence that swells into the final chorus. Same chords as the chorus it lands on, so nothing can clash.

the final chorus, the climax: the build emptied the low end, so the weight crashing back is the hit; an impact the song doesn't have (a sub drop, a noise wash, the song's own snare) lands on it, the music ducks under it and swells to sit louder than drop 1
the final hit and its decay
